label: ajito_doku_020_cassiopeia_01
text: Nice work dealing with the guard.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]

label: ajito_doku_020_cassiopeia_02
text: Within that base lies Team Star’s Poison crew...\nthe Navi Squad.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]

label: ajito_doku_020_cassiopeia_03
text: Their boss, Atticus, designs the outfits for the\nteam—you could say he has clever hands.\r\nThe guy’s also...a bit of an eccentric.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]

label: ajito_doku_020_cassiopeia_04
text: You can never tell what he’s going to do next.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]

label: ajito_doku_020_cassiopeia_05
text: So. Since it’s beyond us to predict how he’ll\nrespond to our declaration of war...[VAR 0x0114(0009)]

label: ajito_doku_020_cassiopeia_06
text: just take out as many of the squad’s Pokémon\nas you can until Atticus shows his face.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]

label: ajito_doku_020_cassiopeia_08
text: Ring the bell on the gates once you’re ready to\nkick off this phase of the operation.\c\nTime to wipe the Navi Squad off the map![VAR 0x0114(0009)]
